programme.title: The Creator / The Creator
programme.desc: Humanity lies with artificial intelligence in a devastating war. The Special Forces agent Joshua is commissioned to find the architect of artificial intelligence and switch it off because it has developed a weapon that could destroy the entire humanity. But when Joshua and his team penetrate the enemy areas, they notice that this weapon is a AI in the form of a child. / Die Menschheit liegt mit einer kunstlichen Intelligenz in einem vernichtenden Krieg. Der Special-Forces-Agent Joshua wird beauftragt, den Architekten der kunstlichen Intelligenz zu finden und ihn auszuschalten, denn dieser hat eine Waffe entwickelt, die die gesamte Menschheit vernichten konnte. Doch als Joshua und sein Team in die feindlichen Gebiete vordringen, bemerken sie, dass diese Waffe eine KI in der Form eines Kindes ist.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 4 / John Wick: Kapitel 4
programme.desc: The contract killer John Wick continues his struggle against the "high chamber" and has now raised half the underworld against it. Wick can formally watch how the bounty continues to increase. His most powerful opponent is the underworld boss Marquis de Gramont, who has gathered strong alliances behind him and who is loyal to his henchmen Shimazu and Killa. His fight against new and old enemies runs from New York Uber Paris and Osaka to Berlin. / Der Auftragskiller John Wick setzt seinen Kampf gegen die "Hohe Kammer" fort und hat mittlerweile die halbe Unterwelt gegen sich aufgebracht. Wick kann formlich zusehen, wie das Kopfgeld auf ihn immer weiter steigt. Sein machtigster Gegner ist der Unterweltboss Marquis de Gramont, der starke Allianzen hinter sich versammelt hat und dem seine Handlanger Shimazu und Killa treu zur Seite stehen. Sein Kampf gegen neue und alte Feinde fuhrt Wick von New York uber Paris und Osaka bis nach Berlin.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.desc: The criminal officer Adrian Monk quickly became a little bit of a small body due to his special facilities in his profession. He has a photographic memory and can make a track even from the smallest indications. Since the death of his beloved wife Trudy due to a mysterious attack, however, he has suffered from strong fears and obsessive -he -forcendants, which leads to his suspension from service at the San Fransisco Police Department. After he has locked himself up in his apartment for three years, he finally becomes a self -timed as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming Lost Monk, the crime trap that nobody else can loose. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. programme.title: The yoga magazine / Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all of this in the home living room _ The "Yoga magazine" makes it possible. Competent and likeable yoga trainers show the best exercises to switch off. The show does not only report from the television studio. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and movement is in the foreground at we move Austria school. The aim of the ORF initiative is to digitally reach schooles and teachers with short movement units and thus to have them taken daily in the Esterreichian classrooms. Neither gymnasium nor sports clothing or special councilors are necessary for this. As an uncomplicated, daily range of movements for the classroom, we want to move Austria school for more exercise and a healthy and balanced way of life. At the start of the expansion of the initiative. We move Austria, 30 episodes with a duration of six to eight minutes with tailor -made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom. The focus is on power, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better use the often stressful school day. The movement units are pronounced by the qualified sports teacher Karin Wildeder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and movement is in the foreground at we move Austria school. The aim of the ORF initiative is to digitally reach schooles and teachers with short movement units and thus to have them taken daily in the Esterreichian classrooms. Neither gymnasium nor sports clothing or special councilors are necessary for this. As an uncomplicated, daily range of movements for the classroom, we want to move Austria school for more exercise and a healthy and balanced way of life. At the start of the expansion of the initiative. We move Austria, 30 episodes with a duration of six to eight minutes with tailor -made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom. The focus is on power, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better use the often stressful school day. The movement units are pronounced by the qualified sports teacher Karin Wildeder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evulanda Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Dr. Blake / Мистериите на доктор Блейк
programme.desc: The Charlotte was found dead at the debut -up ball. Everyone decides she died of a heart attack as her mother. But Dr. Blake finds traces of murder, as well as some of the notes she wrote. / Шарлът е намерена мъртва на бала на дебютантките. Всички решават, че е починала от инфаркт, като майка си. Но д-р Блейк открива следи от убийство, както и част от бележки, които е писала.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Freestyle, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Свободен стил, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

programme.desc: Italian Serie A: Highlights - (Sport. Program, Italy) Serie A is a professional football competition that has 20 teams in the two -round league championship. With the fall of the financial power of the Italian first -team players and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality, but returns safe steps to the place where it belongs. ... / Italian Serie A: Highlights - (sport. program, Italija) Serie A profesionalno je nogometno natjecanje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Dugi niz godina talijanski se nogomet svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Europi. Padom financijske moći talijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. ...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Series, USA, 2017) "30 For 30" The series is critically recognized ESPN sports documentaries, which first came to life as a celebration of the 30th anniversary of the network. The movies were made by talented filmmakers who share inspiring and often touching stories of unforgettable sports moments and culture. They provide an intimate view of the past, show how sports have changed the life of individuals and shares little known or forgotten facts about athletes, teams, fans and events. Pružaju intiman pogled na prošlost, prikazuju kako je sport promijenio život pojedinaca i dijele malo poznate ili zaboravljene činjenice o sportašima, timovima, navijačima i događajima. programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.title: Goodbye Buenos Aires / Adios Buenos Aires
programme.desc: Julio has lost his belief in his country, he wants to go. Corruption, inflation, political chaos, social unrest. And no prospect of improvement. He sells the small shoe duties in Buenos Aires, in which his father was already behind the counter, and informs the rental agreement for the apartment in which he lives with his daughter and mother. He decided to go to Germany with them, where everything will be much better. He is sure of this. Only his old buddies from the Tango combo, in which he plays the Bandoneon, he still has to admit the bitter truth, namely that he gives up and giving up and giving up. / Julio hat den Glauben an sein Land verloren, er will weg. Korruption, Inflation, politisches Chaos, soziale Unruhen. Und keine Aussicht auf Besserung. Er verkauft das kleine Schuhgeschaft in Buenos Aires, in dem schon sein Vater hinter der Theke stand, und kundigt den Mietvertrag fur die Wohnung, in der er mit seiner Tochter und seiner Mutter zusammenlebt. Er hat sich entschieden, mit den beiden nach Deutschland zu gehen, wo alles sehr viel besser sein wird. Dessen ist er sich sicher. Nur seinen alten Kumpanen von der Tango-Kombo, in der er das Bandoneon spielt, muss er noch die bittere Wahrheit gestehen, namlich dass er klein bei- und aufgibt.

programme.title: Hubert without a Staller / Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Together with Hubert and Girwidz, Sabine Kaiser takes a team building measure in the Bavarian Oberland. What the three do not know: Survival coach Ulf Johren was murdered by the two prisoner outlines Jens Lubczyk and Ottmar Fischer and Lubczyk pretends Ulf Johren. However, the tauters did not expect such a repressant prase of the police - it becomes more dangerous for both sides. / Sabine Kaiser unternimmt zusammen mit Hubert und Girwidz eine Teambuilding-MaSSnahme im bayerischen Oberland. Was die drei nicht wissen: Survivaltrainer Ulf Johren wurde von den beiden Gefangnisausbrechern Jens Lubczyk und Ottmar Fischer ermordet und Lubczyk gibt sich fur Ulf Johren aus. Mit einer so reprasentativen Prasenz der Polizei haben aber wiederum die Tater nicht gerechnet - es wird fur beide Seiten brenzlig.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: A young man is found dead on the roadside in the winter Einode of Schleswig-Holstein, just dressed in his underpants. Apparently heavily alcoholic he fell asleep and frozen at night. The commissioners learn from the pregnant girlfriend of the dead that Sebastian wanted to celebrate the expectant fatherhood with friends in the "Schrottfabrik" large discotheque. But it is 20 kilometers from the site. He could have walked this route impossible in his full frenzy. What happened in the last hours before his death? Finn has the victim's mobile data evaluated. Accordingly, the drunk Sebastian near the discotheque was taken up by the police. That night the experienced police chief Rolf Asmus and the police aging Dennis Funke, a nephew of the prosecutor Hilke Zobel, were on patrol. The two police officers claim that they had brought the man to the next taxi rank. There he was not seen by anyone. And why didn't the police not report the use of the provision? When Finn and Lars want to interview the police, Hilke Zobel tears the case. / Ein junger Mann wird, nur mit seiner Unterhose bekleidet, tot am StraSSenrand in der winterlichen Einode Schleswig-Holsteins aufgefunden. Offenbar stark alkoholisiert war er in der Nacht eingeschlafen und erfroren. Von der schwangeren Freundin des Toten erfahren die Kommissare, dass Sebastian die werdende Vaterschaft mit Freunden in der GroSSdiskothek "Schrottfabrik" feiern wollte. Doch die liegt 20 Kilometer vom Fundort entfernt. Diese Strecke konnte er in seinem Vollrausch unmoglich zu FuSS gelaufen sein. Was geschah in den letzten Stunden vor seinem Tod? Finn lasst die mobilen Daten des Opfers auswerten. Demnach ist der betrunkene Sebastian nahe der Diskothek von der Polizei aufgegriffen worden. In dieser Nacht waren der erfahrene Polizeihauptmeister Rolf Asmus und der Polizeianwarter Dennis Funke, ein Neffe der Staatsanwaltin Hilke Zobel, zusammen auf Streife. Die beiden Polizisten behaupten, dass sie den Mann zum nachsten Taxistand gebracht hatten. Dort wurde er aber von niemandem gesehen. Und warum haben die Polizisten den Einsatz nicht vorschriftsgemaSS gemeldet? Als Finn und Lars die Polizisten befragen wollen, reiSSt Hilke Zobel den Fall an sich.

programme.title: orientation / Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

Der Klimawandel fordert seinen Tribut: Wanderwege mussen nach Murenabgangen neu verlegt werden, der Permafrost bedroht die Stabilitat von Berghutten. Das stellt Ehrenamtliche, die beispielsweise die Wege pflegen, vor Herausforderungen und wird vor allem fur die alpinen Vereine zur finanziellen Belastung. Bericht: Kurt Reindl

programme.title: Theme / Thema
programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. Together with Regina and Rita, she has been making headlines at home and abroad for days. The Augustiner choir women are 81, 86 and 88 years old. They have also been house -occupiers since last week. Due to their age, they have been gradually moved to a retirement home for them for them. The sisters don't want to accept that. On your own you have returned to the Goldenstein monastery Sudlich from Salzburg, where you have been living for 70 years. The sisters raise heavy pouring: money and cars are said to have disappeared, the access to their accounts was suddenly not possible. However, the public prosecutor has hired the investigation. The explanation for many open questions is in a centuries -old celebration that the sisters once did. Laura Mlakar and Oliver Rubenthaler report on a story between humanity and canon law. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. The water floods the southern part of Atzenbrugg. Sabine Zischkin can also live in her house again today. The water was one meter high in her living room. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. From one minute to the other, she is alone with three small children. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Aufgrund ihres Alters wurden sie seit 2023 nach und nach von dem fur sie zustandigen Probst in ein Seniorenwohnheim ubersiedelt. Das wollen die Schwestern nicht hinnehmen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.title: cultural Monday / kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: Restart for the Viennese Volkstheater with a big festival and three premieres on a weekend neo-director Jan Philipp Gloger starts his term in the Vienna Volkstheater. The director, born in Germany in 1981, who was most recently acting director at the Staatstheater Nernberg, promises more matchdays and more entertainment at the Volkstheater. He put together a new 20-headed ensemble for this, to which audience favorite Samouil Stoyanov belongs as well as the former Burgtheater star Johanna WOALEK. How is it for young art in Austria? Under what conditions can young artists live from their art? Do buyers prefer to be on the safe side and still decide for established positions? Culture Monday is looking for answers to these questions at the art fairs "Parallel Vienna", "Vienna Contemporary" and in galleries. TV entertainer and author Dirk Stermann presents a new book: "The Republic of the Mand", a historical novel around the poet and glowing nationalist Gabriele Dannunzio, who in 1919 called in today's Rijeka and thus offered fascism an experiment field. Dirk Stermann is a guest in the studio. / Neustart fur das Wiener VolkstheaterMit einem groSSen Fest und drei Premieren an einem Wochenende startet Neo-Direktor Jan Philipp Gloger seine Amtszeit im Wiener Volkstheater. Der 1981 in Deutschland geborene Regisseur, der zuletzt Schauspieldirektor am Staatstheater Nurnberg war, verspricht mehr Spieltage und mehr Unterhaltung am Volkstheater. Dafur hat er ein neues 20-kopfiges Ensemble zusammengestellt, zu dem Publikumsliebling Samouil Stoyanov ebenso gehort wie der ehemalige Burgtheater-Star Johanna Wokalek.Wie ist es um die junge Kunst in Österreich bestellt? Unter welchen Bedingungen konnen junge Kunstlerinnen und Kunstler von ihrer Kunst leben? Gehen Kaufer und Kunstsammlerinnen lieber auf Nummer sicher und entscheiden sich doch eher fur etablierte Positionen? Der Kulturmontag sucht Antworten auf diese Fragen auf den Kunstmessen "Parallel Vienna", "Vienna Contemporary" und in Galerien. TV-Entertainer und Autor Dirk Stermann legt ein neues Buch vor: "Die Republik der Irren", ein historischer Roman rund um den Dichter und gluhenden Nationalisten Gabriele DAnnunzio, der 1919 im heutigen Rijeka den "Freistaat Fiume" ausgerufen und damit dem Faschismus ein Experimentierfeld geboten hat. Dirk Stermann ist zu Gast im Studio.

programme.title: Black + White - Jazzlegende Oscar Peterson / Black + White - Jazzlegende Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: The Canadian jazz pianist Oscar Peterson was a legend during his lifetime. On the occasion of his birthday, which on August 15th for the 100th time, the ORF shows a portrait of the piano virtuoso. From none other than Duke Ellington describes the "Maharaya of the Key", Oscar Peterson is one of the most technically sophisticated and melodic pianists in the history of jazz. In his more than 70-year career, he made 200 own albums and is to be heard on around 400 more, sold more records and gave more concerts than any other pianist in the history of Jazz.Barry Avrich has compiled innumbered archive excerpts from interviews and concert recordings and lets music large ones like Ella Fitzgerald, Quincy Jones, Herbie Hancock and Billy Joel have their say. / Der kanadische Jazzpianist Oscar Peterson war schon zu Lebzeiten eine Legende. Anlasslich seines Geburtstags, der sich am 15. August zum 100. Mal jahrt, zeigt der ORF ein Portrat des Klaviervirtuosen.Von niemand Geringerem als Duke Ellington als der "Maharaja der Tasten" bezeichnet, gilt Oscar Peterson als einer der technisch raffiniertesten und melodisch innovativsten Pianisten in der Geschichte des Jazz. In seiner mehr als 70-jahrigen Karriere hat er 200 eigene Alben veroffentlicht und ist auf etwa 400 weiteren zu horen, hat mehr Platten verkauft und mehr Konzerte gegeben als jeder andere Pianist in der Geschichte des Jazz.Barry Avrich hat fur seinen Film unzahlige Archiv-Ausschnitte aus Interviews und Konzertaufnahmen zusammengetragen und lasst Musik-GroSSen wie Ella Fitzgerald, Quincy Jones, Herbie Hancock und Billy Joel zu Wort kommen.

programme.title: Theme / Thema
programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. Together with Regina and Rita, she has been making headlines at home and abroad for days. The Augustiner choir women are 81, 86 and 88 years old. They have also been house -occupiers since last week. Due to their age, they have been gradually moved to a retirement home for them for them. The sisters don't want to accept that. On your own you have returned to the Goldenstein monastery Sudlich from Salzburg, where you have been living for 70 years. The sisters raise heavy pouring: money and cars are said to have disappeared, the access to their accounts was suddenly not possible. However, the public prosecutor has hired the investigation. The explanation for many open questions is in a centuries -old celebration that the sisters once did. Laura Mlakar and Oliver Rubenthaler report on a story between humanity and canon law. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. The water floods the southern part of Atzenbrugg. Sabine Zischkin can also live in her house again today. The water was one meter high in her living room. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. From one minute to the other, she is alone with three small children. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Aufgrund ihres Alters wurden sie seit 2023 nach und nach von dem fur sie zustandigen Probst in ein Seniorenwohnheim ubersiedelt. Das wollen die Schwestern nicht hinnehmen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.sub-title: Papstlicher als der Papst - Die Piusbruderschaft
programme.desc: The Pius Brotherhood, founded in 1970 by Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre, sees the Catholic Church on a wrong way of modernism and rejects the reforms of the second Vatican Council as a contemporary catholic faith. Its to hold on to the old Tridentine liturgy is only the clearest extraordinary characteristic of her innermost beliefs. Nevertheless, talking to the Vatican has been running for many years to restore the full unit of the once excommunicated brotherhood with the Catholic Church - so far without a breakthrough. What principles do the members of the Pius Brotherhood - priest and laypersons - and how do they allow their view of the church, world and society? Peter Beringer's film follows these questions and also outlines the difficult story of the relationship with Rome. / Die Piusbruderschaft, 1970 von Erzbischof Marcel Lefebvre gegrundet, sieht die katholische Kirche auf einem Irrweg des Modernismus und lehnt die Reformen des Zweiten Vatikanischen Konzils als zeitgeistige Verwasserung des katholischen Glaubens ab. Ihr Festhalten an der alten tridentinischen Liturgie ist nur das deutlichste auSSere Merkmal ihrer innersten Überzeugungen. Dennoch laufen seit vielen Jahren Gesprache mit dem Vatikan, um die volle Einheit der einst exkommunizierten Bruderschaft mit der katholischen Kirche wieder herzustellen - bisher ohne Durchbruch. Nach welchen Prinzipien leben die Mitglieder der Piusbruderschaft - Priester und Laien - und wie begrunden sie ihre Sicht auf Kirche, Welt und Gesellschaft? Der Film von Peter Beringer geht diesen Fragen nach und skizziert dabei auch die schwierige Geschichte der Beziehung zu Rom.

programme.title: Human / iHuman
programme.desc: Everyone is talking about Chatgpt. The mastermind behind the technology developed at Openaai is Ilya Sutskever, one of the experts who have their say in "Ihuman". "Ihuman" is a political thriller. He feels like a science fiction film and is about the here and now. The documentary reveals of artificial intelligence, power and social control. With a unique access to the booming AI industry, he shows how the most powerful technology of all time has our society, our future and our self-understanding. Er fuhlt sich an wie ein Science-Fiction-Film und handelt doch vom Hier und Jetzt. Der Dokumentarfilm erzahlt von kunstlicher Intelligenz, Macht und sozialer Kontrolle. Mit einzigartigem Zugang zur boomenden KI-Industrie zeigt er, wie die machtigste Technologie aller Zeiten unsere Gesellschaft, unsere Zukunft und unser Selbstverstandnis verandert. programme.title: orientation / Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. The water floods the southern part of Atzenbrugg. Sabine Zischkin can also live in her house again today. The water was one meter high in her living room. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.title: cultural Monday / kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: Restart for the Viennese Volkstheater with a big festival and three premieres on a weekend neo-director Jan Philipp Gloger starts his term in the Vienna Volkstheater. The director, born in Germany in 1981, who was most recently acting director at the Staatstheater Nernberg, promises more matchdays and more entertainment at the Volkstheater. He put together a new 20-headed ensemble for this, to which audience favorite Samouil Stoyanov belongs as well as the former Burgtheater star Johanna WOALEK. How is it for young art in Austria? Under what conditions can young artists live from their art? Do buyers prefer to be on the safe side and still decide for established positions? Culture Monday is looking for answers to these questions at the art fairs "Parallel Vienna", "Vienna Contemporary" and in galleries. TV entertainer and author Dirk Stermann presents a new book: "The Republic of the Mand", a historical novel around the poet and glowing nationalist Gabriele Dannunzio, who in 1919 called in today's Rijeka and thus offered fascism an experiment field. Dirk Stermann is a guest in the studio. / Neustart fur das Wiener VolkstheaterMit einem groSSen Fest und drei Premieren an einem Wochenende startet Neo-Direktor Jan Philipp Gloger seine Amtszeit im Wiener Volkstheater. Der 1981 in Deutschland geborene Regisseur, der zuletzt Schauspieldirektor am Staatstheater Nurnberg war, verspricht mehr Spieltage und mehr Unterhaltung am Volkstheater. Dafur hat er ein neues 20-kopfiges Ensemble zusammengestellt, zu dem Publikumsliebling Samouil Stoyanov ebenso gehort wie der ehemalige Burgtheater-Star Johanna Wokalek.Wie ist es um die junge Kunst in Österreich bestellt? Unter welchen Bedingungen konnen junge Kunstlerinnen und Kunstler von ihrer Kunst leben? Gehen Kaufer und Kunstsammlerinnen lieber auf Nummer sicher und entscheiden sich doch eher fur etablierte Positionen? Der Kulturmontag sucht Antworten auf diese Fragen auf den Kunstmessen "Parallel Vienna", "Vienna Contemporary" und in Galerien. TV-Entertainer und Autor Dirk Stermann legt ein neues Buch vor: "Die Republik der Irren", ein historischer Roman rund um den Dichter und gluhenden Nationalisten Gabriele DAnnunzio, der 1919 im heutigen Rijeka den "Freistaat Fiume" ausgerufen und damit dem Faschismus ein Experimentierfeld geboten hat. Dirk Stermann ist zu Gast im Studio.

programme.title: Black + White - Jazzlegende Oscar Peterson / Black + White - Jazzlegende Oscar Peterson

Anlasslich seines Geburtstags, der sich am 15. August zum 100. In seiner mehr als 70-jahrigen Karriere hat er 200 eigene Alben veroffentlicht und ist auf etwa 400 weiteren zu horen, hat mehr Platten verkauft und mehr Konzerte gegeben als jeder andere Pianist in der Geschichte des Jazz.Barry Avrich hat fur seinen Film unzahlige Archiv-Ausschnitte aus Interviews und Konzertaufnahmen zusammengetragen und lasst Musik-GroSSen wie Ella Fitzgerald, Quincy Jones, Herbie Hancock und Billy Joel zu Wort kommen.

programme.title: Crime scene / Tatort
programme.desc: The discovery of a body raises questions: The man missing in the river near Nurnberg was buried two meters deep in the earth for two years. programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. From one minute to the other, she is alone with three small children. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Aufgrund ihres Alters wurden sie seit 2023 nach und nach von dem fur sie zustandigen Probst in ein Seniorenwohnheim ubersiedelt. Das wollen die Schwestern nicht hinnehmen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater.
